author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: इममित्यादित्रयेण ।  अव्ययफलत्वादव्ययम् । इमं योगं 'मयि सर्वाणि' (३.३०) इत्यनेनोक्तम् ।  निवृत्तकर्मलक्षणं ज्ञानोपायं विवस्वते आदित्याय ।  स च स्वपुत्राय मनवे श्राद्धदेवाय स च मनुः स्वपुत्रायेक्ष्वाकवे
translation: V. This Yoga: How to discharge one's duties, i.e., as taught in verse (III-30). It consists of Nivritta Karma, which becomes the means of attaining wisdom. The Yoga Itself is said to be undecaying, as the results (wisdom and release) are of undecaying character.
